_comment: Python import name -> PyPI distribution name. The engine scans the SELECTED skills' .py files
for top-level imports, drops stdlib and skill-local modules, then maps what is left through
this table and pins each distribution to the version installed in the source repo's .venv.
An import that reaches this table with no entry is reported as UNMAPPED rather than silently
dropped — add it here so the runtime's venv is complete. A value of null means 'deliberately
not a dependency' (skip it without warning).
Grounded in an AST scan of every .py file under .agents/skills/ and .sidekicks/skill-offloaded/
as of 2026-08-07; every entry below was verified present in the source .venv via pip freeze.
Keys are the IMPORT name, which often differs from the distribution name (yaml -> PyYAML).
_also_known: Entries below are not currently imported by any skill but are common enough that mapping them
now avoids a spurious UNMAPPED report the first time a skill starts using one.
